acceptance_criteria: Test notification_filter_null_after_before passes. Default serializes to {}.
close_reason: Added serde(default) to after/before fields; added notification_filter_null_after_before and notification_filter_default_serializes_to_empty_object; 29+1 tests pass; clippy clean
description:
**What:** Add tests verifying ShareNotificationFilterCondition.after and .before (typed UTCDate|null per RFC 9670 §3.4.1) accept explicit null JSON input without error.

**Algorithm:**
1. In notification.rs test module, add test notification_filter_null_after_before:
   - Input JSON: {"after": null, "before": null}
   - Assert serde_json::from_str succeeds.
   - Assert fc.after.is_none() and fc.before.is_none().
2. If test fails because serde rejects explicit null for Option<T>, add #[serde(default)] to those fields.
3. Run cargo test -p jmap-sharing-types.

**Defensive programming rules:**
- Test failure messages must name which field failed.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- serde_json::from_str::<ShareNotificationFilterCondition>(r#"{"after":null}"#) succeeds.
- serde_json::to_value(&ShareNotificationFilterCondition::default()) equals {}.
- cargo test -p jmap-sharing-types exits 0.
title: Test ShareNotificationFilter null after/before deserialization
